04 — Straight Answers

Questions we get every week.

What does a society playground actually cost?

It turns on how much equipment the space takes and what goes under it. A single multi-activity structure with a few solo items is a very different figure from a full zoned playground with rubber surfacing. Send the area and a photo of the space and you'll get a built-up figure covering equipment, foundations, surfacing and installation.

How much space do I need?

More than the footprint of the equipment. Every structure needs a clear safety zone around it, and slides and swings need more on the exit side than the rest. That's what the layout drawing is for — we mark the structures and the clearances on your plan so you can see what genuinely fits before anything is ordered.

Do I need safety flooring under the play area?

Under anything children fall from, yes. We supply rubber tiles, poured rubber and artificial grass alongside the equipment, so the surface and the structures are quoted and installed together rather than left to two different contractors.

Is the outdoor gym equipment suitable for a society without a trainer?

That's what it's designed for. The stations use body weight and the user's own resistance — no plates, no pins, nothing to load or adjust. Each unit carries its own usage graphic. For a mixed-age society we usually put a multi-station unit at the centre with cardio and mobility items around it.

Will the equipment survive a Kolkata monsoon?

The play and gym structures are galvanised and powder-coated steel with rotomoulded and FRP components, all specified for outdoor use. The signage goes further — moulded FRP with colour cast into the composite, so there is no painted surface to blister and no rivet joint for water to get into.

Can the signage be made in our brand colour?

Twenty-six standard colours across all ten pylon profiles, with bespoke matches available against order. The faces take vinyl or acrylic embossed graphics, so your logo and wayfinding copy go on exactly as drawn.

Do you install, or only supply?

Both, as one party. Foundations, assembly, anchoring and surfacing are handled by our own crew, so there is one contract and one point of accountability for the finished space.

Can we see the equipment before ordering?

Visit the Experience Centre at 13C Paul Mansions, 6 Bishop Lefroy Road, Mon–Sat 10 AM to 7 PM to go through the three catalogues, colours and finishes with us. For live installations we can point you to completed sites around the city. Call ahead so we can set aside time.
